```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Set the Coordinates

To set the `x` and `y` coordinates use `x` and `y` attributes. If `x` coorindate values are ommitted a cheater plot will be created.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10))
```

### Add Parameter Values

To save parameter values use `a` and `b` attributes.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10)
  )

fig
```

### Add Carpet Axes

Use `aaxis` and `baxis` (`go_carpet_aaxis()` and `go_carpet_baxis()`) to make changes to the axes. For a more detailed list of attributes refer to `go_carpet_aaxis()`.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10),
    aaxis = go_carpet_aaxis(
      tickprefix = "a = ",
      ticksuffix = "m",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9
    ),
    baxis = go_carpet_baxis(
      tickprefix = "b = ",
      ticksuffix = "Pa",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9
    )
  )

fig
```

### Style Carpet Axes

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

fig <- go_figure() |>
  add_carpet(
    a = c(4, 4, 4, 4.5, 4.5, 4.5, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6),
    b = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3),
    y = c(2, 3.5, 4, 3, 4.5, 5, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 10),
    aaxis = go_carpet_aaxis(
      tickprefix = "a = ",
      ticksuffix = "m",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9,
      minorgridwidth = 0.6,
      minorgridcolor = "white",
      gridcolor = "white",
      color = "white"
    ),
    baxis = go_carpet_baxis(
      tickprefix = "b = ",
      ticksuffix = "Pa",
      smoothing = 1,
      minorgridcount = 9,
      minorgridwidth = 0.6,
      gridcolor = "white",
      minorgridcolor = "white",
      color = "white"
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor = "black",
    paper_bgcolor = "black",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(showgrid = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(showgrid = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE)
  )

fig
```
